t: This is 1 Cobham Mews Studios, a Grade II listed architecture studio and office in Camden. It was built between 1987 and 1989, and it was the first building in the United Kingdom designed by David Chipperfield. The critic Lee Mallett called it one of the best buildings of the 1980s. Chipperfield went on to found David Chipperfield Architects in 1985, which has grown into a global practice with offices in London, Berlin, Milan, Shanghai and Santiago de Compostela.
